ITEM 1 | Cubed pale off-white pieces, about 2-2.5 cm each, with golden-tan browned edges and slightly firm, matte surface; scattered across the top of the greens, roughly 25% of the bowl's surface area, moderate thickness about 1.5-2 cm | 150
ITEM 2 | Sliced green avocado wedges, bright-to-olive green flesh with a smooth, slightly glossy surface, about 8-10 cm long and 1 cm thick, fanned in a cluster on the lower left and right of the bowl, covering roughly 10% of the surface | 75
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens: loose, crinkled leaves in dark green, light green, and burgundy-tinged red-edged lettuce, matte and slightly moist, forming a bed across the bowl, covering roughly 40% of the surface, leaves 5-10 cm across and thin | 60
ITEM 4 | Thin slivers of red onion and pale white onion rings, glossy and translucent-edged, about 3-6 cm long, scattered among the greens near the center and right side, covering roughly 5% of the surface | 10
